Summary
ICT has great impact in our daily lives in performing various tasks. Some
examples are data handling,microprocessor-controlledapplications,booking
systems andbankingapplications.
Emerging technologies are technical innovations that represent new
developments within a particular field. Some emerging technologies are
artificial intelligence, biometric, robotics, 3D holographic imaging, virtual
reality,augmentedrealityandself-drivingcars.
System unit is the case that contains all the electronic components of a.
computer system like motherboard,power supply, hard disk, etc.
computerswhichconnectsalltheperipheralsofacomputer.
Central Processing Unit (CPU) is the primary component ofa computer that
processes and executes instructions. It consists of arithmetic logic unit and
controlunit.
Computer memory consistsof RAM and ROM. RAM is temporary memory.It
stores data and programs which are being used by the computer. ROM
permanently stores programs that start the computer when itis turned on and
controls all theinput/outputoperations ofa computer.
Aportispartofmotherboardthatprovides interfacetoconnectinput/output
and storage devices. Some examples of ports are HDMI, USB, VGA and SATA
ports..
All the input/output devices of a computer are known as peripherals. Input
devices are used to enter information into the computer. Output devices
display information on the display screen or print on the printer.
Input/outputdevices provideinteraction between the userandcomputer.
Computer network is interconnection between two or more computers for
the purpose of communication. It has five basic components; servers, clients,
transmission media, connecting devices andnetworkoperating system.
